design.note: Runs of the instability test of 2026-10-28. All are pimpleFoam (OpenFOAM v2212, laminar) runs of the 2D step case from the same developed state at t = 0.1 s, except developed (the run that made that state, from t = 0). Runs that crashed give 'unstable' triples; runs that ended give 'stable' ones (instability_test.py).

path_prefixes: frames/ and requests/ are in this test set, docs/ is the repository

label_rule.note: a run crashed when its log has no 'End' line; it crashed in its last logged step. Triples from a run that crashed are 'unstable'; those ending more than unstable_within_steps steps before the crash are not scored in the balanced count. Runs that ended give 'stable' triples.

note: Each state is drawn once (frames/<run>/<time>/) and used by every triple that has it. The runner replaces only the model name.
